subject.title: [Bug]: Managed Memory Dreaming Promotion cron silently NO_REPLY since 2026-05-09 (jobs.json lastRun stays null)

question: Should managed Dreaming per-workspace failures be promoted into cron-visible failure state, or should cron remain ok while doctor/UI surfaces Dreaming health and repair guidance?
rationale: The storage migrations fixed part of the reported failure, but current code still has a deliberate boundary where memory-core handles workspace failures internally while cron records the outer run result.

options.title: Make failures cron-visible
options.body: Treat all-workspace or promotion-blocking Dreaming failures as cron partial/error state with actionable `lastError` or diagnostics.

options.title: Keep cron ok, add health checks
options.body: Leave the outer cron run as handled but add doctor/UI health checks that report stale Dreaming ingestion, failed workspaces, and WSL workspace guidance.

options.title: Close after live proof
options.body: Close only if a live current-release run proves the original no-op and visibility symptoms are gone in affected-style deployments.

recommendation.title: Make failures cron-visible
recommendation.body: Treat all-workspace or promotion-blocking Dreaming failures as cron partial/error state with actionable `lastError` or diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent SQLite Dreaming-state repair that changed this cluster and are the best available owner for the remaining status/repair contract decision.
